boundary: Owner (line contractor): OHL, conductors and OPGW strung to the tension insulator strings on the Contractor's line gantry, incl. the line clamps. Contractor: gantry, insulator strings and hardware, jumpers and downleads to the GIS outdoor bushings, surge arresters, OPGW joint box on the gantry and fibre to the telecom room.
connection: Line-side terminals of the Contractor's tension insulator strings on the gantry
contractor_side: Gantry, GIS switchyard, protection and metering
isolation: Contractor GIS line bay circuit breaker, line disconnector and line earthing switch; Owner/TSO breaker at the remote end (Kiyi substation).
location_text: Line gantry at the north-west corner
metering: Revenue metering class 0.2S on both line bays (SC-035), TSO approved.
operating_conditions: 380 kV nominal, 420 kV highest; 360-410 kV normal, 342-420 kV up to 30 min; 49.0-51.0 Hz; short-circuit 12-40 kA (2029), 50 kA (2035 planning); connection capacity 640 MW export / 40 MW import (ALP-OWN-ELE-001).
owner_side: Double-circuit 380 kV OHL up to the dead-end tower, conductors to the gantry
protection: Export limiter in the plant control system: 640 MW net at the 380 kV revenue meters (TQ-027); line differential 87L main 1 / main 2 with the remote end (plant end by the Contractor, remote end by the Owner), settings coordinated with the TSO (ER-18.02).
remarks: Short-circuit values include the Alpilla generators' contribution (TSO, TQ-031). Reactive capability per ER-04.08 at the generator terminals (TQ-032).
